project.title: The Potato of Life
project.purpose: A dense relational knowledge archive centered on Tim Dooley, the Potato of Life Myth, Potatoism, the Axis, North, Father and Son, and the world below. The archive favors substantial information over file count: major subjects are chapters inside one knowledge object rather than scattered into many small files.
project.method: Things become understandable through their relationships. Every major subject should preserve identity, chronology, functions, symbols, relationships, evidence status, interpretations, contradictions, consequences and unresolved questions.
project.epistemic_rule: Documentary events, Tim's self-description, Potato of Life Myth, comparative theology, scientific analogy, inference, disputed claims and creative symbolic interpretation may be connected but must not be silently collapsed into the same type of claim.

tim_dooley.title: Tim Dooley
tim_dooley.kind: living myth, central identity, public subject and spiritual axis
tim_dooley.summary: Tim Dooley is the living center of the archive. The archive does not treat Tim as a fictional character or as a flat biography. It preserves a real public-facing subject, a long online presence, a body of self-description, a developing religious and philosophical system, and the Potato of Life Myth that interprets lived events through Father, Son, Potato, Tree, Door, Axis, North, karma, revelation, death, transformation and return. Tim describes himself as God, as working for God, and as one for whom God also works; as Father in Heaven; Potato of Life; World Tree; Heavenly Gardener; King of Kings; Throne of North; North of North; and as living in base reality. These are central claims of Tim's self-description and Potato of Life theology, while documentary verification remains a separate layer.
tim_dooley.identity_and_reality: Tim describes himself as a living myth in base reality. In this usage, myth does not mean fiction: it means that actual life, speech, relationships, conflicts, symbols and public events generate a theological and symbolic structure around a living subject. Tim also rejects reduction of the living being to administrative labels or legal representations. The archive preserves the philosophical distinction between lived being and paperwork without importing pseudo-legal theories.
tim_dooley.god_and_god_relation: Tim's theology contains a recursive relation: Tim says he is God, works for God, and God works for him. Inside the Potato of Life Myth this can be read through source, servant, Father, will, manifestation and action. God can name ultimate source; Tim can name a living worker or expression of that source; and God can also name the greater field that acts through, for and around Tim. The archive treats this as Timic theology rather than trying to flatten it into a single conventional doctrinal formula.
tim_dooley.father: The Father is the upper-center role in the developed architecture. Father is associated with Heaven, Spirit, House, Garden, Throne, Root, North, source, judgment, orientation and organizing intelligence above the Door. Tim identifies himself with this Father-side identity. The archive tracks when this identity became explicit rather than projecting the completed theology backward onto every earlier event.
tim_dooley.son: The Son is the lower embodied and person-facing side of the structure: body, ordeal, descent, suffering, world, Door, death-language, transformation and return. Tim describes the Son as his body or vessel in later theology. The Son belongs to lived chronology, not just abstraction, so the archive separates concrete events, contemporaneous statements and later mythic interpretation.
tim_dooley.father_son_relation: Father and Son are distinguishable but not unrelated. Father is source-side and above; Son is manifestation-side and below; the Door stands between them. In later interpretation the Son's ordeal and death-transformation become part of the condition through which the Father identity is recognized. Tim can therefore speak through both sides while assigning different functions to each.

titles_and_functions.king_of_kings: Spiritual precedence, evaluative authority and responsibility rather than ordinary constitutional kingship. Functions include judge, witness, gardener, banker, center, protector, quest-giver, keeper of thresholds and source of orientation.
titles_and_functions.heavenly_gardener: A gardener observes, prepares conditions, removes obstruction, waters, prunes, protects and allows living things to grow according to their nature. The title links Tim to Potato, Garden, Tree of Life, seed, fruit, nourishment and aligned rather than merely forceful action.
titles_and_functions.world_tree: Tim identifies with the World Tree and Tree of Life: roots descend into matter, conflict, ash, knowledge and consequence; the trunk or Axis passes through the Door; sprouts, leaves and fruit rise toward Spirit, light, Heaven and nourishment.
titles_and_functions.root_and_center: Tim repeatedly occupies the structural role of Root, center or still point. The center is not only dominance; it is the point from which relationships can be integrated. The more central the observer, the greater the responsibility to inspect both self and surrounding system.
titles_and_functions.witness: Tim places importance on prolonged public visibility, streaming, posting and continuous observation as testimony. A witness accumulates a record rather than only making assertions. Primary posts, streams, timestamps, analytics and transcripts are therefore important documentary evidence.
titles_and_functions.spiritual_banker: Tim uses financial language to describe moral accounting. Attention, time, harm, accusation, obligation, repair and consequence can be framed as balances, debt, repayment and default. This symbolic finance is distinct from literal financial obligations but intentionally bridges spiritual and economic language.
titles_and_functions.judge: Tim's self-description includes spiritual judgment: evaluating pride, responsibility, consequence, honesty, distortion, relationship and the ability of a person or system to pass through a threshold toward greater integration.

tim_dooley.powers_and_claimed_functions: Within his spiritual framework Tim attributes unusual powers or offices to himself: spiritual judgment; recognizing hidden relationships; seeing through false paradigms; orienting timelines; acting as witness; opening or interpreting seals; spiritual accounting; identifying karmic debts; gatekeeping through Father/Son and Door architecture; integrating apparently separate traditions and systems; and restoring order through the Axis. The archive preserves these as Tim's claimed functions and attaches concrete examples before describing any supernatural effect as independently established.
tim_dooley.karma_and_karmic_debt: Karma functions as moral causality and accounting. Tim counts accusation, humiliation, betrayal, wasted time, public dog-piling, refusal of accountability, smear campaigns, perceived injury and the treatment of the Son as events capable of producing debt. The symbolic amount has changed over time and has recently been expressed around 42 trillion dollars. The archive treats the number as Tim's spiritual accounting unless connected to an independently established legal or financial obligation. The deeper research object is the ledger beneath the number: incidents, attributed harm, chronology, changes in total, responsibility and what Tim regards as restoration.
tim_dooley.seals_revelation_prophecy: Tim describes himself as opening seals and working inside a revelatory or apocalyptic frame. Revelation means unveiling: a later configuration can make an earlier event newly intelligible. Prophecy is treated more strictly and should be tested by earliest wording, timestamp, intended referent, specificity, later event and the date on which correspondence was first claimed. A seal ledger should similarly record which seal is meant, the relevant biblical text, the event or pattern attached to it and whether the interpretation preceded or followed the event.
tim_dooley.public_presence: Tim's public identity spans long-form streaming, large volumes of video and social posting, repeated direct religious declarations and an emphasis on extreme duration and accumulated public hours. The 100,000-hour spiral functions as a major symbolic threshold in the developed mythology. Platform totals and engagement counts should always be stored as dated measurements rather than timeless numbers.
tim_dooley.public_declarations: A major phase of Tim's public theology includes repeated direct declarations such as 'I am God', 'I am the Father in Heaven', 'I am the God in the Machine', 'I am North of the North Pole', claims that the Son is his body or vessel, and language of return, rapture, North, witness and judgment. These statements should ultimately be indexed by timestamp, platform, surrounding conversation and later doctrinal use.

biblical_self_readings.two_witnesses: Tim applies Revelation's two-witness motif to his Father/Son structure, reading raptured Father above and crucified or returned Son below as a dual witnessing office. This is Timic interpretation of Revelation, not an externally established identification.
biblical_self_readings.mediator: Tim explores the biblical one-mediator problem through a Father/Son office. The claim is paradoxical rather than a simple replacement: one mediating passage can be expressed through distinguishable Father and Son functions.
biblical_self_readings.thief_in_the_night: Tim applies the thief-in-the-night motif to reclamation: taking back what he believes already belonged to him rather than stealing another's possession. The motif connects surprise, judgment, return and restoration.
biblical_self_readings.narrow_gate: The narrow gate is the difficult passage through the Door. It contrasts with the wide momentum of ordinary material life and appears in truth-testing, initiation, transformation, judgment and the demand for greater integration.
biblical_self_readings.guardians: Later imagery places right- and left-hand guardians at the gate, with the narrow passage between them. Their function is protection of the threshold: challenge pride, distortion and destructive impulses before passage.

tim_dooley.mission: Tim's mission is increasingly expressed as integration: make the Potato of Life legible, preserve the history of the Son and Father, map relationships across religion and mythology, develop Potatoism as a living philosophy, create a public archive of evidence and interpretation, map the real world through countries and systems, develop the North Axis and North Programme, preserve Tim's public words and reflections, track karmic and moral accounting, and build a navigable structure in which spiritual and material reality can be examined together without erasing their differences.
research_questions: When did each major Tim title first appear?
Which statements are primary-source public declarations?
How did Father identity emerge from earlier Son-side chronology?
How did the karmic-debt figure evolve?
Which seals did Tim claim to open and when?
Which apparent prophecies were recorded before the interpreted event?
How did North move from sacred orientation into a world-facing programme?
How did public opposition alter Tim's theology and language?

potato_of_life_myth.summary: The Potato of Life Myth is the integrated theological, mythological, philosophical and symbolic structure centered on Tim Dooley and the Potato. Its fundamental unit is relationship rather than isolated entity. Meanings arise through Father and Son, source and manifestation, burial and emergence, Tree and root, Door and transformation, Axis and orientation, Spirit and Matter, North and world, death and renewed life.
potato_of_life_myth.potato: The Potato is powerful because it reverses prestige. It grows underground in darkness and dirt yet stores nourishment and future life. One buried body can sprout many continuations. This makes it a natural symbol for low and high, hidden and manifest, burial and emergence, death and life, ridiculous and sacred, root and fruit, continuity and regeneration.
potato_of_life_myth.geometry: The minimal geometry is two overlapping circles or spheres. The upper domain is Spirit and Heaven, centered on Father/Tim. The lower domain is Matter and World, centered on the Son. Their overlap is the vesica piscis or mandorla and functions as Potato, Door and Wedge. A vertical Axis passes through the whole structure.
potato_of_life_myth.heaven_spirit_father: Heaven is the upper field: Spirit, Father's House, Garden, Throne and widening crown of the Tree of Life. Spirit is living motion through the structure: breath, flow, information, orientation, relation and connective movement. Father occupies the upper center and is associated with Tim, Potato of Life, Root, Throne, House, Gardener and North of North.
potato_of_life_myth.world_matter_son: The lower circle is Earth, globe, world and embodied reality. The Son occupies its center. The lower world represents multiplicity, extension, embodiment, ordinary life, conflict, institutions, economies, cultures, bodies and material consequences. Material existence is not treated as intrinsically evil; it is the field in which distinction, knowledge, consequence and transformation become possible.
potato_of_life_myth.door: The Door is the overlap where Spirit and Matter meet. It is mandorla, vesica piscis, Potato, narrow gate and threshold. Recognition leads to choice; choice to threshold; threshold to transformation. Beginning and ending meet here, allowing death to function not only as termination but as possible transition.
potato_of_life_myth.axis_ladder_spine: The vertical Axis passes through Earth, Son, Door, Father and Heaven. Axis means orientation and ordering; Ladder means movement through levels; Spine means continuity and support. The same central line can perform all three functions without the terms becoming identical.
potato_of_life_myth.tree_of_life_and_roots: The Tree of Life is the upward form: sprout, widening, leaf, light, fruit, nourishment and Heaven. The downward form is Roots of Strife, Roots of Ash and symbolically the roots of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil. Strife emphasizes conflict and division; Ash emphasizes destruction, death and residue; Knowledge emphasizes distinction, judgment and polarity. The strongest reading is one organism in two directions rather than two unrelated trees.
potato_of_life_myth.transformation_sequence: distinction → conflict → knowledge → consequence → transformation → life
potato_of_life_myth.ash_cycle: Tree → fire/death → ash → soil → root → Potato → sprout → Tree
potato_of_life_myth.eye: The Potato's eyes are literal growth points and also symbolic openings. In the myth they can become sprouts, roots, dimensions, directions and carvings of light. The Eye performs perception, discernment, integration and evaluation. Seeing becomes a potential direction of growth.
potato_of_life_myth.red_blue_potato: Red represents creativity, love, light-seeking, expansion and generative risk. Blue represents memory, fear, contraction, preservation and defensive enclosure. They are complementary tendencies, not simply good and evil. Living systems need both generativity and boundary.
potato_of_life_myth.house_garden_throne: The Father's House represents upper containment, differentiated rooms or perspectives and spiritual dwelling. The Garden represents cultivated living order. The Throne represents the culminating point of orientation and judgment. Tim's symbolic anatomy sometimes associates House with thalamus and Door or single eye with pineal; these are Potato of Life metaphors rather than established neuroscience.
potato_of_life_myth.effortless_action: Roots move toward ground while sprouts move toward light. The spiritual lesson is aligned action rather than passivity: when relation and orientation are correct, growth follows its proper direction without unnecessary self-violence.
potato_of_life_myth.truth_layers: A symbolic resemblance can be meaningful without proving historical influence. A scientific analogy can illuminate a myth without proving theology. A self-description can be authoritative for the internal system without being independent biography. A later revelation can transform the meaning of an earlier event without proving the earlier person predicted the later interpretation.

chronology_and_entanglement.method: Each major event should be stored as event ↔ experience ↔ public statement ↔ audience response ↔ later interpretation ↔ Potato of Life Myth meaning. This preserves both lived history and later theological structure.

timeline.meaning: Early reading, mythology, experimentation, music, conflict with institutions and unusual spiritual curiosity belong to the prehistory of the later myth but should not be retroactively presented as fully formed Potatoism.

timeline.event: Distinct Son-side Tree or hanging ordeal later interpreted through Yggdrasil, sacrifice, altered perception, unity, spirals, crows, runes, Axis and return.
timeline.status: major autobiographical and mythic anchor; later interpretation must be distinguished from contemporaneous understanding

Distinct Son-side crucifixion, meme-crucifixion, death or transformation complex later coupled to Christmas, North Pole, Door and Ladder imagery.
timeline.status: canonical mythic threshold with multiple narrative strata

chronology_and_entanglement.real_world_entanglement: The Potato of Life Myth is not sealed off from ordinary history. It developed through public identities, streams, posts, audiences, detractors, platform events, dated experiences, memes, conflicts and later interpretations. External hostile archives and criticism can be evidence that a public interaction ecology existed without being treated as neutral proof of every allegation they contain.
chronology_and_entanglement.son_father_research: The Father/Son relation requires a documentary chain: Son-side events, contemporaneous statements, later crucifixion/death/return language, emergence of Father identity and the date when the two were explicitly connected. The central historical question is how lived chronology became Father/Son spiritual architecture.
chronology_and_entanglement.karma_research: For karmic claims, record the underlying event separately from Tim's moral interpretation: accusation, ridicule, dog-piling, platform action, smear, conflict, lost time or perceived harm can be documented where evidence exists; the associated karmic value remains Tim's spiritual accounting unless independently established otherwise.

potatoism_and_philosophy.summary: Potatoism is a developing spiritual philosophy rather than a closed creed. It uses the ordinary potato, root systems, growth, burial, nourishment and transformation to think about identity, suffering, responsibility, knowledge, relationship and return.

principles.relationship_before_isolation: An entity becomes intelligible through what it depends on, what depends on it, what transforms it, what it mediates, what it resembles and what it contradicts.
principles.burial_before_emergence: Growth often begins invisibly. The buried state can look like absence or death while still containing future life.
principles.nourishment_test: Spiritual systems should ultimately be judged partly by what they nourish, repair, clarify or enable rather than only by grandeur of language.
principles.humility_without_erasure: The potato is lowly but not worthless. Humility should reduce false prestige without demanding annihilation of value or identity.
principles.suffering_transformed: Suffering is not worshipped for its own sake; its spiritual value lies in whether it becomes knowledge, responsibility, compassion, boundary, nourishment or renewed life.
principles.centered_action: Correct orientation allows roots to move toward ground and sprouts toward light. The goal is not inactivity but action aligned with structure and reality.
principles.memory_and_creation: Blue memory and preservation must not become imprisonment; Red creativity and expansion must not become reckless loss of continuity. Healthy life integrates both.
principles.knowledge_to_life: Knowledge of distinction is incomplete if it remains trapped in division. The path is distinction → conflict → knowledge → consequence → transformation → life.
principles.return: Return is reintegration after transformation, not simple reversal to an untouched earlier state.

potatoism_and_philosophy.ethics: Potatoism emphasizes responsibility for relationships, consequences, nourishment and repair. Spiritual status without responsibility is treated as incomplete. The higher or more central a claimed position, the greater the obligation to integrate evidence, inspect the self, repair harm and remain accountable to reality.
potatoism_and_philosophy.development_rule: Earlier symbols may acquire later meanings and apparently contradictory formulations can belong to different developmental strata. The archive should preserve how the philosophy changed rather than rewriting the past to make the mature system appear timeless.

bible_and_comparative_tradition.method: Comparison is structural and relational, not automatic identity. Similar motifs can be historically independent. The archive compares function, sequence, symbolism, language, theology and contrast while preserving differences.

christianity.father_son_spirit: Potato of Life theology uses Father, Son and Spirit relationally: Father/source above; Son/manifestation below; Spirit/flow connecting the structure. This invites comparison with Christian Trinity while differing significantly from orthodox formulations.
christianity.tree_cross_ladder: Tree ordeal, crucifixion, Tree of Life, narrow gate, Jacob's Ladder, Father's House, seed dying and producing life, mediator, thief in the night, two witnesses and Revelation seals all function as major comparative nodes.
christianity.door: Jesus' Door imagery is compared with the Potato mandorla and Son threshold. The comparison is strongest at the level of function—passage, mediation, transformation and entry—rather than as proof of historical identity.
christianity.grain_and_potato: The dying grain that produces new life provides a structural Christian parallel to burial, hidden life, death and regeneration in the Potato symbol.

norse.odin_yggdrasil: The 2011 Tree ordeal is compared with Odin hanging on Yggdrasil: ordeal, suspension, wounding or sacrifice, altered perception, knowledge, runes, transformation and return. The comparison is archetypal and structural rather than a claim that Tim or the Son is literally historical Odin.
norse.world_tree: Yggdrasil provides a strong comparative structure for an Axis linking worlds, roots, beings, knowledge, fate and upper/lower realms.

bible_and_comparative_tradition.other_traditions: The broader archive may compare mandorla/vesica geometry, sacred mountains, axis mundi, gardens, world trees, resurrection cycles, initiation thresholds, divine kingship, mystical participation and sacred north across traditions. Every comparison should record both resemblance and difference.

axis_north_and_world.summary: The Axis begins as spiritual orientation and expands into sacred geography, a four-quadrant world model, a North Programme and an evidence-backed relational map of nations, economies and institutions.
axis_north_and_world.axis: The Axis is not best reduced to a literal physical dimension. It is orientation or flow through structural, symbolic or descriptive space. A Tree can embody one; a Ladder can describe movement along it; a Door can mark transition between states.
axis_north_and_world.north: North develops from sacred orientation into Throne of North, North of North, North Gate and North Axis. Denmark and Greenland become major real-world anchors, with a wider arc involving Canada/Greenland, Scandinavia/Finland, Britain/Ireland, Iceland, continental Europe/EU, Ukraine and Turkey. Estonia belongs within the broader northern field rather than necessarily being a primary anchor.
axis_north_and_world.quadrants: The developed model uses NORTH, WEST, EAST and SOUTH. North is the primary integrative direction; West has been associated especially with the United States and Israel; East with China, BRICS and eastern power structures; South with Australia and parts of Africa in provisional mappings. These are project interpretations, not objective scientific divisions of humanity.
axis_north_and_world.country_sequence: what a country is → what it has → what it can do → what it needs → who depends on it → what it depends on → what it can only do with others → what others can only do with it → what it is building → where it is going
axis_north_and_world.economic_graph: The world layer should map legal entities, ownership and control, money, debt, obligations, companies, infrastructure, procurement, funding, trade and value chains, energy, finance, technology, research, labor, skills, strategic dependencies and geopolitical ties. Evidence should come from public registers, procurement systems, ownership sources, EU funding and state-aid records, input-output tables, sector accounts and similarly auditable datasets.
axis_north_and_world.world_below: The lower world includes countries, governments, political systems, intelligence and security organizations, cults and high-control groups, esoteric schools, influence networks, culture, media, infrastructure, technology, finance and disputed or hidden relationships. The archive must distinguish official mandate, documented history, verified operations, allegations, criticism, uncertainty and speculation rather than collapsing them into unsupported conspiracy narratives.
axis_north_and_world.potato_dynamics: A provisional formalization writes the system as P = (S,g,A,D,O,I): state/configuration space, geometry or metric, Axis flow, Door transition maps, observables and information/integration structure. Structural flow dX/ds = A(X,g) is distinguished from ordinary physical evolution. Renormalization-group flow is a legitimate mathematical analogy for scale-dependent description, not evidence of a newly discovered physical force.
axis_north_and_world.speculative_science: Dimensional, pineal/thalamus, string/M-theory, compactification, Starchforce and similar ideas belong to Potato of Life speculation or metaphor unless independently supported by established science.

archive_rules.density: Create a new top-level chapter only when a subject is substantial enough to deserve many paragraphs of durable information. Otherwise add it inside an existing chapter.
archive_rules.no_duplicate_tim: Tim Dooley is the single master identity object. Journey, entanglement, karma, titles, public declarations, Son/Father theology and mission belong inside Tim or chronology sections unless a future dataset becomes genuinely too large for one file.
archive_rules.evidence: Prefer dated primary artifacts, official sources and strong provenance. Preserve hostile or partisan sources with stance labels. Do not treat criticism or allegation as neutral fact simply because it is externally published.
archive_rules.chronology: Do not silently resolve chronology conflicts. Preserve competing dates and investigate the source trail.
archive_rules.editing: Favor fewer, larger, denser sections. Do not create placeholder files. Do not create files whose only purpose is to hold a handful of terms or metadata that can live inside this document.
